text: We have identified that the vast majority of families lack the proper to substantiate ownership of the assets comprising their estates, as well as the relevant contracts, agreements, or deeds. Even when such documents exist—such as in the case of trust agreements—they are often not kept up to date. To address this gap, we created Trust Book: a specialized service that identifies our clients’ investments and relevant documents to verify that they are properly organized from an accounting, legal, and tax perspective and that they accurately reflect the clients’ current intentions. Through Trust Book, clients can consolidate their data and relevant documents in one place, enabling them to track each change chronologically and keep everything duly updated. Clients—or their designated family members—also have secure access to obtain copies at any time.
